properties.name: weakcrypto:config
properties.value: skill pq-crypto, 2 scouts, max iterations 400, build bbcd802706e4

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pycryptodome is the symmetric-cipher provider in the build; eth-keyfile/eth-account use it for Ethereum keystore encryption (AES-128-CTR). Its legacy cipher modules (3DES, RC4, Blowfish) ship alongside. Availability-in-shipped-library, not an application call site — the defect class is the build shipping a broken cipher, fixable by upgrading pycryptodome and pruning legacy modules. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency: cryptography==2.4.2 (requirements.txt line 11) bundles RSA keygen/encryption/signing and X.509. This Ethereum token-sale codebase has no RSA call site, but the pinned 2018-era dependency ships the capability into the build. Changeable here: upgrade or drop the pin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: cryptography 2.4.2 is a general crypto provider in the shipped build; the project's live ECDSA runs through the eth-keys/secp256k1 stack instead (see the separate findings for ico/sign.py). Changeable by upgrading — 2.4.2 is 2018-era with an old bundled OpenSSL, no PQ or hybrid capabilities.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES available through pinned cryptography==2.4.2; no AES call site in application code. Symmetric, quantum-safe in practice (Grover halves AES-128 to a 64-bit quantum margin).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is the standard KDF for Ethereum keystore files (eth-keyfile, also declared). Quantum-safe as a password KDF. No direct first-party call site found; presence recorded per dependency-inventory rules. The scrypt package itself is also tracked as LIB-073173ef in the other shard.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 available via Werkzeug==0.12.2; requirements.txt additionally declares pbkdf2==1.3 and eth-keyfile==0.5.1 (Ethereum keystore encryption uses PBKDF2/scrypt + AES-128-CTR). No direct PBKDF2 call site in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dep-level TLS posture: requests==2.20.1 over urllib3==1.22 (2017 pins) — TLS 1.2 with classical ECDHE/RSA key exchange, no TLS 1.3, no post-quantum groups. tls_sessions found no outbound TLS session setup in this tree's own code; the requests stack talks to a local geth node over HTTP/IPC.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Governance artifact: the root store that decides which TLS endpoints requests/urllib3/web3 will trust. Every anchor is RSA- or ECDSA-signed (quantum-unsafe), and the 2017 pin predates current roots. PQ migration of trust anchors is ecosystem-gated, but the pin is trivially changeable here by upgrading certifi.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 certificate machinery in the build; any TLS path verifies against classically-signed (RSA/ECDSA) chains. Migration to ML-DSA certificates is ecosystem-gated; the dependency version is changeable here. Recorded as shipped-library capability with no direct call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared scrypt KDF package (requirements.txt line 52), also reachable transitively through eth-keyfile keystore encryption. The algorithm-level object for the same dependency is ALG-c1f8b585 (other shard) — same dependency seen as a library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Cross-referenced so a reader has one entry for the trust store: the CA bundle (ALG-065af532) is the artifact, certifi the package that ships it. Upgrading the pin refreshes the roots.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: urllib3==1.22 pinned at a 2017 release; defines TLS transport defaults (TLS 1.2, classical groups only, no TLS 1.3). No direct use in application code found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Serves as the symmetric backend for Ethereum keystore encryption (eth-keyfile: AES-128-CTR + scrypt) and as an optional keccak backend for eth-utils. Declares the build's symmetric-crypto capability surface. Upgradeable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: requests==2.20.1 declared; would carry the TLS/CA-bundle posture (certifi 2017.7.27.1) for any outbound HTTPS call. No outbound HTTPS session setup found in this tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: General-purpose OpenSSL-backed provider in the shipped build (2018 vintage). The application's signature path bypasses it in favor of eth-keys/secp256k1; recorded as declared-provider presence. Upgradeable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Werkzeug==0.12.2 declared; ships PBKDF2 password hashing and secure-cookie signing (HMAC). No direct call site in application code.
